purpose: Validation gates every strategy must pass before leaderboard eligibility, plus the demotion gate that returns a live strategy to paper. All gate text, sample windows and thresholds were frozen before first exposure to data.

validation_gates.name: Minimum out-of-sample sample
validation_gates.rule: At least 300 graded out-of-sample games before a strategy can qualify.
validation_gates.evidence: Week 10-11 sample is 14-13 games; the 136-game pre-registered backtest corpus lives in sibling namespaces (nfl-core/nfl-marketboard) and is not re-hosted here.

validation_gates.name: Probabilistic calibration
validation_gates.rule: Model Brier score must beat the 0.2500 constant baseline with a paired-bootstrap 95% CI that excludes 0.
validation_gates.evidence: No graded forecasts exist yet in this namespace.

validation_gates.name: Discrimination vs home-team baseline
validation_gates.rule: Win probability must beat the home-team baseline with one-sided p < 0.05.
validation_gates.number_to_clear: accuracy edge over home baseline, p < 0.05

validation_gates.name: Totals skill
validation_gates.rule: Originated total MAE must beat the naive baseline by a permutation-tested margin (p < 0.05).
validation_gates.evidence: Fair total is v1 league-average baseline; not yet graded.

validation_gates.name: Temporal stability
validation_gates.rule: Skill must be stable across chronological blocks (no single block driving the result).

validation_gates.name: Dependence control for combinations
validation_gates.rule: Every combination leg reports measured dependence (n and CI); no leg priced under independence.
validation_gates.evidence: Same-game parlays and prop combos are blocked before any independence assumption is made. Cross-game leg dependence r = -0.007 (peer-verified, n week-slates) is reported, not assumed zero.

validation_gates.name: Executable price
validation_gates.rule: ROI/CLV may only be computed at an executable (official or licensed) price.
validation_gates.evidence: The NFL publishes no odds anywhere (re-checked 2026-11-15). No official or licensed price exists in this repo.

validation_gates.name: Multiple-testing control
validation_gates.rule: Strategy-level p-values pass Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.05 across all trials run.
validation_gates.evidence: No strategy has a p-value yet.

validation_gates.name: Source and usage compliance
validation_gates.rule: Every published row links to its official page; the NBA/NFL Stats download restrictions are acknowledged.
validation_gates.evidence: This site: every table row carries a source link; unverified values are blank and flagged.

validation_gates.name: Deterministic reproduction
validation_gates.rule: Rebuild reproduces every page and number byte-for-byte (modulo timestamps).
validation_gates.evidence: build.py is deterministic; verify.py checks row source-links and local links.

demotion_gate.name: Live-to-paper demotion gate
demotion_gate.rule: A strategy marked LIVE is demoted to PAPER when any auto-firing condition triggers, evaluated weekly after results settle.
conditions: DG-1a: Brier skill vs baseline turns negative over the rolling 4-week window
DG-1b: realized CLV at executable price is negative for 4 consecutive weeks
DG-1c: maximum drawdown exceeds the pre-registered limit (flagged: no limit set yet)
DG-1d: any input source fails the drift alarm (missing field / row-count breach) for 2 consecutive captures
demotion_gate.current_state: No strategy is LIVE. All 7 strategies are PRE-REGISTERED or BLOCKED. Demotion gate evaluated: 0 triggers, 0 live strategies demoted, 0 actually live today.
demotion_gate.number_to_clear: a strategy must first pass G1-G10 before it can be LIVE; only then does DG-1 apply
